arabic text: NAY BOLEYA SAARE RASTE VICH\nHOREYA SUNDA TILAAWATE SHAADI
english translation text: SAJJAD (AS) DID NOT SPEAK THE WHOLE JOURNEY, AS HE LISTENED TO THE TRAGEDY OF HIS FATHER

arabic text: BAUW AANKHI NIBHAYI AABID (AS) NE HAY MANZIL SHAAM DE RAA DI
english translation text: HE WEPT THE WHOLE WAY TO SHAAM AND FINISHED THE JOURNEY WITH GREAT DIFFICULTY

arabic text: KADI VEKHE NAUKE SINA DE VAL\nKADI YAAD AAVE BAQIYA DI
english translation text: ZAINAB (SA) WOULD LOOK TOWARDS THE HEAD OF IMAM HUSSEIN (AS) ON THE SPEAR AND SHE WOULD REMEMBER BAQI

arabic text: KAVE SUNKE SHAUR SHARABIYAN DA HAY KISMAT AUN DI MA DI
english translation text: AND THEN SHE WOULD HEAR THE MISCHIEF OF THE DRUNKARDS\nOH THE FATE OF THE MOTHER OF AUN (AS)..
